The '''Frisal system''' was located in the [[Atrisian Commonwealth/Legends|Atrisian Commonwealth]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the terrestrial<ref name="Planets">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Frisal]],<ref name="CSWE Frisal" /> which was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the eight-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilians]] known as [[loirbnigg]]s.<ref name="Planets" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained Frisal as a preserve world for wealthy Imperial families.<ref name="CSWE Frisal" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Frisal [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square J-12.<ref name="TEA" />
